data.text:
PROJECT ADVISORY: Long Term East 3 – Cayetano Boulevard Project Update

The ongoing Long Term East 3 – Cayetano Boulevard Project is now 90% complete.

We acknowledge that the prolonged construction and repeated delays have caused significant inconvenience to motorists, commuters, and residents of Taguig. We sincerely apologize for the disruption, particularly along Cayetano Boulevard and nearby areas, and we thank the community for their patience as we work to finish these essential improvements.

This December 2025, the Manila Water will be conducting road restoration works along segments of Cayetano Boulevard. The schedule is as follows:

• December 2: Temporary asphalt near C-5 cor. Cayetano Boulevard — Completed
• December 5: Restoration works near Petron and General Luna — For completion
• December 15: Restoration works near Grace Mall — For completion
(Restoration activities will be done every Saturday to help reduce traffic impact.)

We appreciate the community’s understanding as we work to bring long-term water enhancements to Taguig City. We also continue to coordinate with the City Government of Taguig to manage traffic flow, ensure safety, and minimize inconvenience to motorists and residents.
